layer1.name: Buffer
layer1.one_liner: Schedule social media posts to go out at the best times.
layer1.description: Queue posts once and have them published on a schedule across accounts. Started as a two-page landing test before any product existed, sold as a low-priced subscription.
layer1.outcome_note: Publishes its revenue openly. Around $25.9M ARR and $2.2M MRR at the time of retrieval, with roughly 239,000 monthly active users.

sources.note: Live public revenue and customer metrics
